# Stable Garrison
[italic]Date 2183 - Stable Garrison, a UA controlled frontier world with a joint base and sizeable urban community.[/italic]
## The Carbon Ravine Disaster (2168) As operations expanded aggressively, more and more heavy equipment was built and moved into the deep ravines and rolling hills of [bold]Albacetire[/bold]. The colony was already pulling in billions.
Then came [bold]the Ravine Incident[/bold].
During routine deep-core excavation, Drill Site 68-B punctured an immense subterranean ravine system filled with highly pressurized carbon monoxide and volatile gases, trapped for millennia beneath layers of impermeable rock.
Over 1,200 miners suffocated in the tunnels within minutes, a silent and deadly death. No safety measures had been put in place for a gas leak of this size. The carbon monoxide blew out of the mine and settled over the mining camp, claiming even more lives, and it was not over.
A planetary wind shift carried the expanding toxic cloud straight toward the nearby garrison and mining township. Entire residential blocks suffocated, emergency responders failed to contain it and vehicles stalled. By the time orbital monitors detected the gas bloom, it was too late.
The official death toll passed [bold]12,000 colonists[/bold] before the wind shifted again, carrying the gas high into the atmosphere where it diluted. Among the dead were [textlink="Colonial Marines" link="CMUGuideLoreUSCM"], [textlink="Royal Marines" link="CMUGuideLoreOrgRMC"] and [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] personnel stationed in ground garrisons near the mining plant.
## Political Fallout and the Stability Mandate Public outrage erupted across human space. [textlink="UNISC" link="CMUGuideLoreUNISC"] was deployed to handle the humanitarian crisis, alongside emergency responses from the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] (UA), the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE) and Weyland-Yutani (W-Y).
Under intense political pressure, the three signed the [bold]Albacetire Stability Mandate[/bold], which brought massive reinvestment into the colony's infrastructure, safety and security, and established [bold]Joint Base Schaefer[/bold], a prominent mountain fort.
## Joint Base Schaefer Built atop the ruins of an old UA garrison, Joint Base Schaefer became the physical symbol of shared control over the colony.
- The mountain complex houses the United States Colonial Marines, the Royal Marine Commandos and [textlink="Weyland-Yutani PMC" link="CMUGuideLoreWYPMC"] contractors. - Its purpose is to defend the colony from dissident activity, respond to mass emergencies, monitor the atmosphere and geology, and above all secure the colony's valuable assets. - The locals nicknamed the fort [bold]"Stable"[/bold].
## The Boom of Albacetire - After the reinvestment, Albacetire grew explosively. Wealthy figures moved to the colony and brought their families with them. - Sprawling, high-tech mines were opened, along with massive greenhouse domes to make use of the nutrient-rich soil. The colony was soon worth billions. - Its population grew to around [bold]1,250,000[/bold], many of them investors, businesspeople, researchers and students of the colony's prestigious [bold]University of Albacetire[/bold]. - By 2178 it was considered one of the most economically vital cities in the Neroid Sector, and a hub for prospectors across the region.
